description:
Per JMAP-sc1b.110 policy narrowing: classifier-attribute strings on data-object sub-types in externally-owned-schema-mirror type crates (jscalendar-types, jscontact-types) should NOT be typed enums.

JMAP-sc1b.77 (commit 3e27837) converted 10 enumerated-string sites in jscalendar-types to 8 typed enums via the `impl_string_enum!` macro. This bead reverts that change.

## Scope (concrete)

### crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/src/lib.rs (10 sites)

Restore the following fields to bare `String` (or `Option<String>` if previously optional):

  - NDay.day                     (was Weekday)
  - RecurrenceRule.frequency     (was Frequency)
  - RecurrenceRule.skip          (was Skip)
  - RecurrenceRule.first_day_of_week (was Weekday)
  - Location.relative_to         (was LocationRelativeTo)
  - Participant.kind             (was ParticipantKind)
  - Participant.participation_status (was ParticipationStatus)
  - Participant.schedule_agent   (was ScheduleAgent)
  - OffsetTrigger.relative_to    (was OffsetTriggerRelativeTo)
  - Alert.action                 (was AlertAction)

Remove the 9 `impl_string_enum!` invocations and the 8 enum type definitions.

### crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/Cargo.toml

Remove the `jmap-types = { workspace = true }` dep. The crate goes back to its no-JMAP-dep posture (matches the AGENTS.md isolation constraint that jscontact-types also enforces).

### crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/AGENTS.md

If JMAP-sc1b.77 added any 'jmap-types dep is allowed for the macro' language, remove it. Restore the original no-JMAP-dep statement.

### Tests

Remove the 18 round-trip tests added by .77 for the typed enums. If any of those tests covered serde shape that is still relevant for the bare-String case, keep those tests but adjust the type expectations.

### Consumer: crate-jmap-calendars-types

This crate consumes jscalendar-types and may have method signatures or pattern-matches that touch the typed enums. Audit:

  - Any `use jmap_jscalendar_types::{Weekday, Frequency, Skip, LocationRelativeTo, ParticipantKind, ParticipationStatus, ScheduleAgent, OffsetTriggerRelativeTo, AlertAction}` imports → remove.
  - Any `match` arms on those types → restore string-literal comparisons.
  - Any test fixtures that construct typed enum variants → restore string-literal construction.

### Consumer: crate-jmap-calendars-server

Same audit. May have handlers that pattern-match on Participant.kind or similar.

## Acceptance

  - All 10 sites in jscalendar-types restored to bare String (or Option<String>) with original PLAN.md rationale ('preserve forward-compatibility') re-asserted in doc comments where relevant.
  - jmap-types dep removed from crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/Cargo.toml.
  - Consumer crates (calendars-types, calendars-server) compile and test clean.
  - cargo test --workspace clean.
  - cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings clean.
  - Cross-reference comment added on JMAP-sc1b.77 noting this revert and the policy reason.

## Cross-references

  - JMAP-sc1b.110 — workspace AGENTS.md policy narrowing (the basis for this revert)
  - JMAP-sc1b.77 — the original conversion being reverted (already closed; this bead does not reopen it, just supersedes its outcome)
  - JMAP-sc1b.108 — parallel jscontact-types decision (closed wontfix; this revert restores jscalendar-types to match)

## Out of scope

  - JMAP-native result enums (MailboxRole, ChatKind, etc.) — those stay typed per JMAP-sc1b.110's preserved in-scope policy.
  - jscontact-types — never had the typed enums in the first place (JMAP-sc1b.108 was the propagation bead, closed wontfix).
title: Revert JMAP-sc1b.77: un-type jscalendar-types classifier-string enums
